paidNote: Free: learn from 1 website, up to 3 notes/month, basic models. Plus $10/mo or $100/yr.
summary: Privacy-first AI browser for Mac, Windows, iOS, Android that learns, with permission, from sites you log into (bank, clinic, school) to answer personal questions. Encrypted sync claimed; XDA called it middle-of-the-pack.
bestFor: People who want AI answers from their own logged-in sites

pros.title: Client-side encryption
pros.detail: Vendor says chats and learned pages are encrypted on-device and stay encrypted in sync.

pros.title: Personal answers
pros.detail: Learns from sites you log into, only with explicit permission.

cons.title: Unaudited privacy claims
cons.detail: Encryption and no-training claims are vendor statements.

cons.title: Sensitive data scope
cons.detail: Reading banking and medical portals raises risk if mishandled.

cons.title: Mediocre review
cons.detail: XDA found it "oddly middle-of-the-pack" for a privacy-led product.

cons.title: Opaque engine and extensions
cons.detail: Site does not state the browser engine or extension support.

faq.a: Yes with limits (1 learned website, 3 notes/month); Plus is $10/mo or $100/yr.
Mac, Windows, iOS and Android; the iOS app is listed on the App Store.

faq.q: Is my data used for training?
faq.a: The vendor says never; this is unverified.

timeline.event: AI browser launched (press coverage around Jun 25)

jsSpeed: Blink/V8 engine, Chrome-class JS speed; no vendor benchmark
pageLoad: Chromium rendering; AI sidebar adds overhead
networkSpeed: Chromium network stack with HTTP/3 and preloading
startup: Chromium cold start, heavier than plain Chrome
memory: Chromium multi-process plus AI layer; RAM-heavy
cpu: Chromium-class; agent tasks add background load
lowEnd: Needs modern hardware; AI features add load
installSize: Full Chromium bundle, a few hundred MB
blocking: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite are available
securityHardening: Chromium sandbox and site isolation; agent injection risk
patchSpeed: Follows Chromium stable; lag not independently measured
behaviourCustom: Few shortcut or per-site options documented
tabManagement: Tab groups and search; no workspaces documented
searchFreedom: Default search changeable; AI prompt flow is the focus
translation: AI-driven page translation; no dedicated engine
accessibility: Chromium accessibility stack, unverified for AI layer
businessTrust: Privacy claims unaudited; mid-pack independent review
longevity: Existing mobile app lineage, new desktop browser

featureNotes.adBlocker: Only MV3 blockers such as uBO Lite
featureNotes.commandBar: Address bar doubles as AI prompt
featureNotes.mv2Support: MV2 removed upstream; Chrome Web Store dropped MV2 Aug 31, 2026
featureNotes.agenticBrowsing: Answers from learned sites; not autonomous

unverified: 700,000 downloads (previous AI app, from press release)
